independence_declaration.statement: qa-verifier authored no product implementation in the DG1 scope. The F-DG1-147 change in this round (apps/web/tsconfig.e2e.json and the apps/web typecheck script) was not authored by me. My only candidate-tree contributions are the test-first acceptance suites under tests/qa/** and e2e/** (the permitted qa scope). I formed this verdict before reading any other reviewer's round-4 record and did not open any of them. Their files were hidden in my staging view, and the reconcile validator output names no verdicts. All code execution happened in disposable clones under $TMPDIR, which were removed afterwards.

checks_run.procedure: Independent negative test of F-DG1-147 in the disposable clone. First list the files the e2e project covers (tsc --listFilesOnly). Then inject a TS2322 type error (1) into apps/web/e2e/journeys.spec.ts and (2) into the root playwright.config.ts, and run the apps/web typecheck for each. Repeat (1) through the root entry point 'pnpm -r typecheck'. Revert each mutation with git checkout and rerun the control. Informational: run an ad-hoc tsc over the QA-authored root e2e/*.spec.ts, which are outside the tsconfig.e2e.json scope.
checks_run.expected: control 0; every mutation non-zero, naming the error location; restored 0
checks_run.actual: Covered files: apps/web/e2e/journeys.spec.ts and playwright.config.ts. The control exited 0. Mutation 1 exited 2 with 'e2e/journeys.spec.ts(474,7): error TS2322'. Mutation 2 exited 2 with '../../playwright.config.ts(32,7): error TS2322'. Mutation 3 through pnpm -r typecheck exited 2. After restoring, git status was clean and pnpm -r typecheck exited 0. The informational ad-hoc tsc of the root e2e/*.spec.ts exited 0.

checks_run.procedure: Black-box SQL probe on a fresh disposable database. Migrate, then migrate again to confirm idempotence. Check that audit_event rejects UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE for mth_app, mth_owner and the superuser. Check that the business-unit hierarchy rejects a cycle and a depth of 11 levels.
checks_run.expected: 9 migrations applied, then 'up to date'; every tamper attempt refused; cycle and depth 11 refused
checks_run.actual: The first migrate applied 9 migrations and exited 0. The second reported 'database is up to date' and exited 0. All nine audit_event tamper attempts failed: permission denied for mth_app, and 'append-only' for mth_owner and postgres. The cycle was refused with 23514 'cannot be placed under its own descendant'. D1 to D10 inserted, and D11 was refused with 'nested deeper than 10 levels'.

summary: PASS on candidate 6e0c0db1 (commit 642e6bf). The only product change since round 3 is F-DG1-147: apps/web/tsconfig.e2e.json, and the typecheck script now also checks the e2e files. pnpm -r typecheck passes, and an independent negative test shows a type error in apps/web/e2e or playwright.config.ts now fails it (exit 2). No regression elsewhere: build and static checks pass; unit tests 326/326 on Node 22 and on Node 24; integration 209/209 twice (9 migrations, guard 7/7, contract 9/9 including getBrandingTokens); A12/A13/A14 24/24; e2e journeys 18/18 in EN and AR with no skips; QA acceptance 22/22; A20 token propagation; A18 clean start at 642e6bf; validators register, pipeline and reconcile PASS; the A24 offline surface and the REQ-DLV-042 offline suite (13/14) pass. Live CI (D-058) and the live-registry install effect (D-057) are disclosed residuals; only their offline surfaces were verified. Informational: pnpm deps:verify needs the live registry and was not run to completion; it is not an assigned check. No new findings.
